# `morethemes`: more themes for matplotlib

<img src="https://github.com/JosephBARBIERDARNAL/static/blob/main/python-libs/morethemes/image.png?raw=true" alt="morethemes logo" align="right" width="150px"/>

**`morethemes`** provides themes for [matplotlib](https://matplotlib.org/). More themes, better plots, one line of code.

[![PyPI Downloads](https://static.pepy.tech/badge/morethemes)](https://pepy.tech/projects/morethemes)

[Documentation site](https://y-sunflower.github.io/morethemes/)

<br>

## Installation

```bash
pip install morethemes
```

Don't want to add **`morethemes`** as a dependency? You can either browse the [source code](https://github.com/y-sunflower/morethemes/blob/main/morethemes/themes.py) to find the rcParams, or use the `mt.get_rcparams("theme_name")` function.


<br>

## Themes


```{python}
# | output: asis
# | echo: false

import morethemes as mt
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

static_themes = [theme for theme in mt.ALL_THEMES if theme != "brand"]
print(
    f"**`morethemes`** offers 16 built-in themes, as well as a special 'brand' theme, based the [_brand.yml specification](https://posit-dev.github.io/brand-yml/):\n"
)

for theme in static_themes:
    print(f"### {theme.upper()}\n\n")
    print("```python")
    print("import morethemes as mt")
    print(f'mt.set_theme("{theme}")')
    print("```\n")
    fig = mt.preview_theme(theme)
    fig.savefig(f"img/{theme}", dpi=200, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.close()
    print(
        f"[![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/y-sunflower/morethemes/refs/heads/main/docs/img/{theme}.png)](https://y-sunflower.github.io/morethemes/)"
    )
    print("\n")

print("### BRAND\n\n")
print(
    "The `brand` theme reads a Posit [`_brand.yml`](https://posit-dev.github.io/brand-yml/) file and generates Matplotlib rcParams from its colors and typography.\n"
)
print("```python")
print("import morethemes as mt")
print('mt.set_theme("brand")')
print("```\n")
```
